#1
संन्यासस्य|saṃnyāsasya|saṃnyāsa — renunciation, relinquishment (from sam-ni-as, 'to lay/cast aside completely') (gen. sg. masc., 'of renunciation')
महाबाहो|mahā-bāho|mahā — great (first member);;bāhu — arm (mahā-bāho: 'great-armed one', vocative sg. masc., addressed to Kṛṣṇa)
तत्त्वमिच्छामि|tattvam icchāmi|tattva — the true nature, the essential truth (of) (acc. sg. neut., object of icchāmi; simply joined, final -m unaffected before the vowel);;iṣ — to wish, desire (icchāmi: present 1st sg., 'I wish [to know]')
वेदितुम्|veditum|vid — to know (veditum: infinitive complementing icchāmi, 'to know')
--
त्यागस्य|tyāgasya|tyāga — relinquishment, giving-up, abandonment (gen. sg. masc., 'of relinquishment')
च|ca|ca — and
हृषीकेश|hṛṣīkeśa|Hṛṣīkeśa — 'lord of the senses', Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)
पृथक्केशिनिषूदन|pṛthak keśiniṣūdana|pṛthak — separately, individually (adverb, 'each on its own');;Keśiniṣūdana — 'slayer of Keśin', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa recalling his killing of the horse-demon Keśin (vocative sg. masc.)
#2
काम्यानां|kāmyānām|kāmya — done from desire, optional, motivated by a wish for reward (kāmyānām: gen. pl. neut., agreeing with karmaṇām)
कर्मणां|karmaṇām|karman — action (gen. pl. neut., 'of actions')
न्यासं|nyāsam|nyāsa — a laying-down, a giving-up (acc. sg. masc., object of viduḥ)
संन्यासं|saṃnyāsam|saṃnyāsa — renunciation (acc. sg. masc., predicate complement, 'as renunciation')
कवयो|kavayaḥ|kavi — a sage, a seer, a wise man (nom. pl. masc., subject; -aḥ before v- → -o)
विदुः|viduḥ|vid — to know (viduḥ: perfect 3rd pl., 'they know')
--
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं|sarva-karma-phala-tyāgam|sarva — all (first member);;karma — action (second member);;phala — fruit (third member);;tyāga — giving-up, relinquishment (sarva-karma-phala-tyāgam: 'the giving-up of the fruit of all action', acc. sg. masc., predicate complement)
प्राहुस्त्यागं|prāhuḥ tyāgam|pra-ah — to declare, call (prāhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl., 'they call'; -uḥ+t- → -us t-);;tyāga — relinquishment (acc. sg. masc., predicate complement)
विचक्षणाः|vicakṣaṇāḥ|vicakṣaṇa — discerning, learned, clear-sighted (nom. pl. masc., subject)
#3
त्याज्यं|tyājyam|tyaj — to abandon (tyājya: gerundive, 'is to be abandoned'; nom. sg. neut., predicate)
दोषवदित्येके|doṣavat iti eke|doṣavat — faulty, possessing fault (doṣavat: nom. sg. neut., predicate agreeing with karma; doṣavat+iti → doṣavad iti, -t+i- → -d i-);;iti — thus (closing the quoted view; iti+eke → ityeke, -i+e- → -y e-);;eka — one; eke, 'some [people]' (nom. pl. masc., subject)
कर्म|karma|karman — action (nom. sg. neut., subject of the quoted clause, object of prāhuḥ)
प्राहुर्मनीषिणः|prāhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ|pra-ah — to declare (prāhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl.; -uḥ+m- → -ur m-);;manīṣin — a thoughtful man, a sage (manīṣiṇaḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject)
--
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म|yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma|yajña — sacrifice (first member);;dāna — giving (second member);;tapas — austerity (third member);;karman — action (yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma: 'the action of sacrifice, giving and austerity', nom. sg. neut., subject)
न|na|na — not
त्याज्यमिति|tyājyam iti|tyaj — to abandon (tyājya: gerundive; nom. sg. neut., predicate; simply joined with iti, final -m unaffected before the vowel);;iti — thus (closing the quoted view)
चापरे|ca apare|ca — and (ca+apare → cāpare, a+a → ā);;apara — other (apare: nom. pl. masc., subject, 'others')
#4
निश्चयं|niścayam|ni-ci — determination, settled conclusion, verdict (niścaya: acc. sg. masc., object of śṛṇu)
शृणु|śṛṇu|śru — to hear (śṛṇu: imperative 2nd sg., 'hear!')
मे|me|aham — I (me: gen. sg., 'my')
तत्र|tatra|tatra — there, on that point, in that regard (adverb)
त्यागे|tyāge|tyāga — relinquishment (loc. sg., 'concerning relinquishment')
भरतसत्तम|bharata-sattama|Bharata — descendant of Bharata (first member);;sattama — best (bharata-sattama: 'best of the Bharatas', vocative, addressed to Arjuna)
--
त्यागो|tyāgaḥ|tyāga — relinquishment (nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before h- → -o)
हि|hi|hi — for, indeed (particle)
पुरुषव्याघ्र|puruṣa-vyāghra|puruṣa — man (first member);;vyāghra — tiger (puruṣa-vyāghra: 'tiger among men', vocative, addressed to Arjuna)
त्रिविधः|trividhaḥ|tri-vidha — threefold (nom. sg. masc., predicate)
संप्रकीर्तितः|saṃprakīrtitaḥ|sam-pra-kīrt — to proclaim, declare (saṃprakīrtita: past participle; nom. sg. masc., predicate, 'is proclaimed')
#5
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म|yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma|yajña — sacrifice (first member);;dāna — giving (second member);;tapas — austerity (third member);;karman — action (yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma: 'the action of sacrifice, giving and austerity', nom. sg. neut., subject)
न|na|na — not
त्याज्यं|tyājyam|tyaj — to abandon (tyājya: gerundive; nom. sg. neut., predicate)
कार्यमेव|kāryam eva|kṛ — to do (kārya: gerundive, 'is to be done'; kāryam: nom. sg. neut., predicate; simply joined with eva, final -m unaffected before the vowel);;eva — indeed, precisely
तत्|tat|tad — that (nom. sg. neut., resuming yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma, subject, repeated for emphasis)
--
यज्ञो|yajñaḥ|yajña — sacrifice (nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before d- → -o)
दानं|dānam|dāna — giving (nom. sg. neut., subject)
तपश्चैव|tapaḥ ca eva|tapas — austerity (tapaḥ: nom. sg. neut., subject; -aḥ+c- → -aś c-);;ca — and;;eva — indeed (ca+eva → caiva, a+e → ai)
पावनानि|pāvanāni|pāvana — purifying (nom. pl. neut., predicate agreeing collectively with the three preceding subjects)
मनीषिणाम्|manīṣiṇām|manīṣin — a thoughtful man, a sage (gen. pl., 'for the wise')
#6
एतान्यपि|etāni api|etad — these (etāni: nom. pl. neut., resuming yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma of verse 5; etāni+api → etānyapi, -i+a- → -y a-);;api — even, indeed
तु|tu|tu — but, however
कर्माणि|karmāṇi|karman — action (nom. pl. neut., in apposition to etāni)
सङ्गं|saṅgam|saṅga — attachment, clinging (acc. sg. masc., object of tyaktvā)
त्यक्त्वा|tyaktvā|tyaj — to abandon (tyaktvā: gerund, 'having abandoned')
फलानि|phalāni|phala — fruit (acc. pl. neut., second object of tyaktvā)
च|ca|ca — and
--
कर्तव्यानीति|kartavyāni iti|kṛ — to do (kartavya: gerundive, 'are to be done'; kartavyāni: nom. pl. neut., predicate agreeing with etāni karmāṇi; kartavyāni+iti → kartavyānīti, i+i → ī);;iti — thus (closing the quoted view)
मे|me|aham — I (me: gen. sg., 'my')
पार्थ|pārtha|Pārtha — son of Pṛthā, Arjuna (vocative)
निश्चितं|niścitam|ni-ci — determined, settled, definite (niścita: past participle; nom. sg. neut., predicate agreeing with matam)
मतमुत्तमम्|matam uttamam|man — opinion, view (mata: nom. sg. neut., subject; simply joined with uttamam, final -m unaffected before the vowel);;uttama — highest, best (uttamam: nom. sg. neut., predicate)
#7
नियतस्य|niyatasya|ni-yam — prescribed, fixed, obligatory (niyata: past participle; gen. sg. neut., agreeing with karmaṇaḥ)
तु|tu|tu — but
संन्यासः|saṃnyāsaḥ|saṃnyāsa — renunciation (nom. sg. masc., subject)
कर्मणो|karmaṇaḥ|karman — action (gen. sg. neut., 'of action'; -aḥ before n- → -o)
नोपपद्यते|na upapadyate|na — not (na+upapadyate → nopapadyate, a+u → o);;upa-pad — to be fitting, to apply, to be proper (upapadyate: present middle 3rd sg.)
--
मोहात्तस्य|mohāt tasya|moha — delusion (mohāt: abl. sg., 'out of delusion'; mohāt+tasya simply joined, dental+dental);;tad — it, its (tasya: gen. sg., referring back to niyatasya karmaṇaḥ)
परित्यागस्तामसः|parityāgaḥ tāmasaḥ|pari-tyāga — abandonment, relinquishment (parityāgaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ+t- → -as t-);;tāmasa — tamas-natured (tāmasaḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate)

#8

यत्कर्म|yat karma|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, object of tyajet);;karman — action (karma: acc. sg. neut.)
कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्|kāya-kleśa-bhayāt tyajet|kāya — body (first member);;kleśa — affliction, trouble (second member);;bhaya — fear (kāya-kleśa-bhayāt: 'out of fear of bodily hardship', abl. sg.; simply joined with tyajet, dental+dental);;tyaj — to abandon (tyajet: optative 3rd sg., 'should abandon')
--

#9

श्रीर्विजयो|śrīḥ vijayaḥ|śrī — splendor, fortune, prosperity (śrīḥ: nom. sg. fem., subject; -iḥ+v- → -ir v-);;vijaya — victory (vijayaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before bh- → -o)

नीतिर्मतिर्मम|nītiḥ matiḥ mama|nī — right conduct, statesmanship, policy (nīti: nom. sg. fem., subject; -iḥ+m- → -ir m-);;man — opinion, conviction (mati: nom. sg. fem., predicate, 'is my conviction'; -iḥ+m- → -ir m-);;aham — I (mama: gen. sg., 'my')
